findings.description: Global pollution/override of Section A, B, and C subtitles and instructions. By hardcoding _SECTION_SUBTITLE and _SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS globally for sections A, B, and C to 'Biology', 'Chemistry', and 'Physics' to suit the new board layout, the builder breaks all non-board presets (like 'unit_test' and 'half_yearly') which also use sections A, B, and C but map them to question types (MCQ, VSA, SA). For non-board papers, the MCQ section will get the label 'Biology' and Biology-related instructions, which is incorrect.

Key casing discrepancy for marks_by_question_type. The backend endpoint PaperFormatsView in backend/papers/views.py returns lowercase keys like 'mcq', 'very_short_answer', etc., while the frontend component fallback structure maps keys as 'MCQ', 'VSA', 'Case'. This leads to inconsistent formatting on the UI when fallback is used versus when a format is selected, and will break tests if not aligned.
